name: Networked Battleship
shortDesc: A simple game of Battleship in the terminal running over a network with 2+ clients and a server.
desc: A simple game of Battleship in the terminal running over a network with 2+ clients and a server. Clients can connect to a specific address and port, set their username, start a game of battleship, fire on other players, view their map, and surrender the game. The server handles the game state, and communication to and from clients.
details: This project was a project done for CS465: Computer Networking at Western Carolina University. This was a partnered project and was not done solely by me, as such I have not reuploaded this to a public GitHub as I cannot claim the entirety of the work as my own.
